title: RaceChrono Lap Session Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Garmin Zumo ride data (`garmin:zumo`), motorcycle OBD-II telemetry (`obd:bike`), RaceChrono laps (`racechrono:lap`), REVER rides (`rever:ride`), and RevZilla orders (`revzilla:order`).
app: Garmin Zumo ride exports, motorcycle OBD-II telemetry, RaceChrono track sessions, REVER ride logs, and RevZilla order history forwarded into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=racechrono:lap
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by track_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>72
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when RaceChrono lap session data has stopped arriving for a given track name.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per track name and alert when the feed is older than 72 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors when one part of your RaceChrono lap session feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
